text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fully aware of the disadvantage she'll face due to her size, Tamamo Cross takes on her first big challenge of the Classic Triple Crown—the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The rival of the day is Gold City. Tamamo Cross might not hold a candle to her flashy looks, but the real contest is the race ahead.
